rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the Court together with a narrow, as-applied opinion grounding § 922(g)(8) in a preventive-justice tradition (surety/going-armed analogues) and emphasizing notice, hearing, individualized threat findings, and temporariness. Thomas likely dissents to insist the bond-versus-disarmament difference is one of kind under Bruen, while one or more conservatives (especially Kavanaugh/Barrett/Alito) may write separately to underscore limits (e.g., ex parte orders or orders lacking credible-threat findings).
